checks: Published headless command lists two encrypted accounts without token/email output or data writes
Actual headless import preserves existing accounts, encrypted format and user preferences
Production headless switch applies the selected fictional login and preserves the exact previous login
Switching the already-current account does not replace previous-login backup or ciphertext
Unknown account selection fails before login or encrypted-data mutation
A nonexistent saved session never changes the selected login or fabricates a new session
An actual external native app-server blocks switching without stopping it or altering credentials
The native CLI session list does not misrepresent an empty app-server metadata thread as saved CLI work
A non-CLI metadata thread is refused before changing the login or encrypted data
Interactive resume without a TTY fails before changing the login
Resume launch binds the original descriptor, UUID and folder with one explicit follow-up and no permission override
Noninteractive resume exposes real upstream JSON events without a permission or session-selection override
Ambiguous/implicit session targets and incomplete/duplicate options are refused
Duplicate account aliases require the explicit stable account ID
scope: Actual native terminal executing the real published headless commands with fictional local account data. No personal account, real authentication, inference or active-task continuation.
